name: issue_resolution_sweep
description: Resolve labeled open issues into pull requests without duplicate work.

repo.description: 'owner/name' GitHub repository slug to sweep for labeled open issues.

agent.description: Coding agent identifier passed through to each dispatched issue-resolution child workflow.

approvalJudgePromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the approval judge, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

approvalJudgePromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the approval judge prompt template.

approvalMode.description: Approval mode passed through to each dispatched child workflow (e.g. human or auto).

codePromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the coding step, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

codePromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the code prompt template.

designJudgePromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the design judge, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

designJudgePromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the design judge prompt template.

designPromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the design step, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

designPromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the design prompt template.

issueLabel.description: Label an open issue must carry to be eligible for this sweep.

judgeAgent.description: Coding agent identifier used for judge steps, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

judgeMaxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum USD budget for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

judgeMaxTurns.description: Maximum turns allowed for judge steps in each dispatched child workflow.

judgeModel.description: Legacy single-model override for judge steps, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

maxActive.description: Maximum concurrently-active in-flight automation runs allowed before new candidates are capacity-blocked.

maxApprovalRevisions.description: Maximum number of approval revision rounds allowed in each dispatched child workflow.

maxNew.description: Maximum newly-eligible issue candidates to dispatch this sweep.

model.description: Legacy generic model override applied to plan and code roles in each dispatched child workflow.

planPromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the planning step, passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

planPromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the plan prompt template.

verificationProfile.description: Named verification profile passed through to each dispatched child workflow.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select; empty string defers to the policy's default profile.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path inside the worktree to a repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role overrides merged on top of the selected model profile's roles.

scanned.description: Number of open labeled issues fetched from GitHub for this sweep.

eligible.description: Number of issue candidates selected for dispatch within capacity.

dispatched.description: Number of candidates dispatched this sweep; currently mirrors 'eligible'.

claimed.description: Number of candidates dispatched this sweep; currently mirrors 'eligible' and does not reflect the actual per-candidate claim outcome (see childWorkflowIds for that).

skipped.description: Issue candidates excluded from dispatch, each annotated with a 'reason' (e.g. retry_backoff, suppressed, exhausted, label_or_state, linked_pr).

blocked.description: Otherwise-eligible issue candidates deferred purely due to capacity (reason: 'capacity').

childWorkflowIds.description: Map of each dynamically forked automation_dispatch task's reference name to its output; one entry per eligible candidate dispatched this sweep.

childWorkflowId.description: Workflow instance id of the started child issue-to-PR workflow; empty string if the claim was lost and no child was started.

claimed.description: True if this dispatch won the race to claim the issue revision and started the child workflow.
